name: V13 Geometric Control

configuration.name: v13-geometric-supervised-single-candidate
configuration.start: runs/retained/selected/latest.pt, scratch-A 16384 PPO lineage decisions; original weights preserved
configuration.actor: unchanged official 13D GRU64, 26181 parameters, original tensor names and four-action decoder
configuration.labels: Only official observation x: Chase when ball_present=1; steer=clip(2*atan2(ball_right,ball_forward),-1,1). Neutral and zero steer for unavailable ball. No pretrained teacher or opponent output labels.
configuration.data_mix: 40 wide-orientation ground, 10 forced standard kickoff (five positions/both sides), 20 moving-ball ground, 10 normal starts; plus 8 explicitly counterfactual missing-ball sequence augmentations
configuration.optimizer: fresh supervised Adam lr .001, no PPO moments; mode cross-entropy + 2*Chase steering MSE; norm clip1
configuration.prediction_weights: Candidate only: initialize six unavailable-forecast encoder columns to zero, preserve those zero columns during supervised fitting. Runtime still consumes unchanged 13D; no runtime masking or extra parameters.
configuration.opponent: untouched official V13; retained A and untouched baseline also tested under same conditions
configuration.confirmation_rule: Only if >.5 conservative screening score and improved ground/kickoff; fresh paired-seed confirmation exact sign p<.05, caps treated as losses. No reuse for tuning.
configuration.promotion: Requires convincing independent results AND actual Windows RLBot acceptance. Linux cannot provide the latter; preserve main.
configuration.no_repeat: One fit only; stop if unsuccessful. No PPO continuation, external pretrained weights, or old-project data.
